title: Ton Up Pro
tagline: One purchase. Everything in the app, including camera scoring.

items.title: 21 more games
items.body: Tactics, Mickey Mouse, Halve-It, Baseball, Golf and the rest of the rules library, with bots.

items.title: The full practice library
items.body: 12 more drills, a skill assessment, a plan that adapts to your weak spots, a checkout trainer and pressure mode.

items.title: Deeper analysis
items.body: Where you miss relative to your aim, drift and grouping, your personal aim map, trends, and a ghost bot that throws like you.

items.title: Four more themes
items.body: Chalkboard, Arcade, Heritage and Training, each in light and dark.

items.title: Camera scoring
items.body: Snap the board after your visit and Ton Up reads your darts; the fixed camera follows as a free update.
